snippets.name: Callouts
snippets.description: highlighted notes inside an article. A bold first word labels them; data-tone colors them.

snippets.name: Card grid
snippets.description: a section of linked cards, such as blog posts, projects, or products. Each card is an <article>.

snippets.name: Confirm dialog
snippets.description: a button opens a modal with no page script (commandfor/command); clicking the backdrop, Escape, or Cancel closes it.

snippets.name: Contact form
snippets.description: labeled fields with help text, validation messages shown under each field, a character counter, and a busy submit button.

snippets.name: Data table
snippets.description: sortable columns (click a header), a filter box that hides rows as you type, and status badges. Sort values go in <data value> and <time datetime>.

snippets.name: Docs layout
snippets.description: a docs page with breadcrumbs, a generated table of contents that follows the scroll, heading anchor links, copy buttons on code, and previous/next links.

snippets.name: FAQ
snippets.description: an accordion where one answer is open at a time (the shared name), and the page remembers which.

snippets.name: Feature grid
snippets.description: three cards with an icon, a heading, and a sentence each. Add or remove <article>s; the grid adapts.

snippets.name: Footer columns
snippets.description: a site footer with an about line, link columns, and a copyright. Replace the <footer> of your page.

snippets.name: Hero
snippets.description: the page header of a landing page, with a big promise, two calls to action, and a picture beside them. Replace the <header> of your page.

snippets.name: Page header
snippets.description: a title and subtitle with action buttons on the same row. Put it first in <main>.

snippets.name: Pricing table
snippets.description: three plans as cards, with a price, what's included, and a button.

snippets.name: Search bar
snippets.description: a search field with filters and a button in one row, sent to the server as a GET form.

snippets.name: Sidebar layout
snippets.description: an app page with a full-height sidebar, a top bar, and the content beside it. This is the whole <body>.

snippets.name: Stat tiles
snippets.description: a row of key numbers with a change for each. A <dl> whose items are wrapped in <div>s becomes tiles.

snippets.name: User menu
snippets.description: a top bar with a dropdown account menu. Without JavaScript the menu links simply show in the bar.

templates.name: Admin table
templates.description: a page to manage records, with breadcrumbs, a title row with an action, a filter box, a sortable table with status badges, and an "invite" form in a modal dialog.

templates.name: Blog post
templates.description: an article with author and date, a lead image that enlarges, sections with anchor links, a pull quote, code with a copy button, a sortable table, a callout, and related posts.

templates.name: Dashboard
templates.description: an app page with a full-height sidebar, a top bar with an account menu, stat tiles, a sortable and filterable orders table, and a ranked list.

templates.name: Docs page
templates.description: breadcrumbs, a generated table of contents that follows the scroll, heading anchor links, code with copy buttons, a tip callout, and previous/next links.

templates.name: Landing page
templates.description: a hero with a picture, a feature grid, pricing plans, testimonials, an FAQ accordion, a call to action, and a footer with link columns.

templates.name: Sign-up page
templates.description: a single-form page with help text, a password show/hide toggle, checkboxes, a switch, a character counter, and validation messages under each field.
